label: A necessary concrete power-holder for no contingent concretum, by Aristotelian modality
meaning: Analyst reconstruction of Pruss's Aristotelian-modality argument. A concrete being is contingent at w, so the global possibility (no contingent concretum) fails at w, while it holds at some accessible world (P4). Aristotelian grounding (P1) gives a being y existing at w with a power for it; initiator presence (P2) gives an accessible world v where it obtains and y exists; y is concrete (P3), so y is not contingent at v. With excluded middle y exists at every world accessible from v, and Euclidean access makes every world accessible from w accessible from v.
